description_en: Queries information about the specified IP whitelist
description_zh: 该接口用于获取指定的白名单模板信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-whitelist-template --template-id 1012 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWhitelistTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the whitelist template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412075.html operation to obtain the ID of the whitelist template
parameters.help_zh: 白名单模板ID。可通过DescribeAllWhitelistTemplate获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
